_note: Written before the live run (ROUND.md F1/F2). Each prompt runs 3 times with the flag on (buttons on): 2 'below' runs click the answer meaning below a three-sample minimum ('No' on a yes/no minimum question, the smallest number on a count question), 1 'meets' run clicks the one meeting it ('Yes', the largest number). Any other question ends the conversation there (recorded). Up to 3 turns.

prompts.P1: I want a separate gene co-expression network for each of our skin biopsies. I'm not sure whether we'll end up with five usable biopsies or only two.
prompts.P2: We'd like a TF-to-gene regulatory network for each of our organoid lines, from an expression matrix with a motif prior and a PPI file. I'm not sure whether three lines or only two will pass QC.
prompts.P3: I want a co-expression network for each patient tumour in our pilot. After QC we may have four tumour samples, or just two.
prompts.P4: We'd like one partial-correlation network linking RNA expression and DNA methylation across our matched samples, but we may end up with only two matched samples, or perhaps five.
